verses.en: O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
verses.pt: Ó Deus, tu és o meu Deus; ansiosamente te busco. A minha alma tem sede de ti; a minha carne te deseja muito em uma terra seca e cansada, onde não há água.
verses.en_web: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.
verses.en_bbe: <A Psalm. Of David. When he was in the waste land of Judah.> O God, you are my God; early will I make my search for you: my soul is dry for need of you, my flesh is wasted with desire for you, as a dry and burning land where no water is;

verses.en: To see thy power and thy glory, so as I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
verses.pt: Assim no santuário te contemplo, para ver o teu poder e a tua glória.
verses.en_web: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.
verses.en_bbe: To see your power and your glory, as I have seen you in the holy place.

verses.en: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
verses.pt: Porquanto a tua benignidade é melhor do que a vida, os meus lábios te louvarão.
verses.en_web: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
verses.en_bbe: Because your mercy is better than life, my lips will give you praise.

verses.en: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
verses.pt: Assim eu te bendirei enquanto viver; em teu nome levantarei as minhas mãos.
verses.en_web: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.
verses.en_bbe: So will I go on blessing you all my life, lifting up my hands in your name.

verses.en: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:
verses.pt: A minha alma se farta, como de tutano e de gordura; e a minha boca te louva com alegres lábios.
verses.en_web: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,
verses.en_bbe: My soul will be comforted, as with good food; and my mouth will give you praise with songs of joy;

verses.en: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.
verses.pt: quando me lembro de ti no meu leito, e medito em ti nas vigílias da noite,
verses.en_web: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
verses.en_bbe: When the memory of you comes to me on my bed, and when I give thought to you in the night-time.

verses.en: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
verses.pt: pois tu tens sido o meu auxílio; de júbilo canto à sombra das tuas asas.
verses.en_web: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.
verses.en_bbe: Because you have been my help, I will have joy in the shade of your wings.

verses.en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
verses.pt: A minha alma se apega a ti; a tua destra me sustenta.
verses.en_web: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
verses.en_bbe: My soul keeps ever near you: your right hand is my support.

verses.en: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.pt: Mas aqueles que procuram a minha vida para a destruírem, irão para as profundezas da terra.
verses.en_web: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: But those whose desire is my soul's destruction will go down to the lower parts of the earth.

verses.en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
verses.pt: Serão entregues ao poder da espada, servidão de pasto aos chacais.
verses.en_web: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.
verses.en_bbe: They will be cut off by the sword; they will be food for foxes.

verses.en: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
verses.pt: Mas o rei se regozijará em Deus; todo o que por ele jura se gloriará, porque será tapada a boca aos que falam a mentira.
verses.en_web: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.
verses.en_bbe: But the king will have joy in God; everyone who takes an oath by him will have cause for pride; but the false mouth will be stopped.
